decision.description:
OPA policy evaluation decision. ALLOW maps to TRUE, DENY maps to FALSE, and PARTIAL
indicates that document criteria must be evaluated by the request interceptor.
decision.title: OpaPolicyTestDecision

criteriaGroups.description:
OR groups containing AND document criteria returned by partial evaluation. Empty
when decision is ALLOW or DENY.

criteria.description: AND criteria within this group. Groups are combined using OR.

key.description: Document attribute key referenced by the partial criterion.

operator.description: Document attribute comparison operator produced by partial evaluation.
operator.title: OpaPolicyTestOperator

value.description: String, number, boolean, array, or null value used by the criterion.

400.description: Invalid OPA access policy test request

401.description: User is not authenticated or does not have ADMIN privileges for the site

404.description: No saved OPA access policy exists for the site

requestId.description: Request identifier used to locate restricted diagnostic logs.
